[[File:Moorja_installation.jpg|thumb|right|200px|Smugglers overlook the training grounds.]]
The '''Moorja Training Installation''' was designed to provide refresher courses for squads from different [[Sector fleet/Legends|Sector Fleets]], which rotated out of the base on a weekly basis.<ref name="G2">{{GamerCite|2|The Lambda Heist}}</ref>

Located in a remote region of the planet [[Moorja/Legends|Moorja]], on the edge of crumbling badlands, its existence was kept largely a secret from the natives. The outpost contained limited facilities: a [[command bunker]], two modular [[Barracks/Legends|barracks]], various storage sheds, a mess hall and a motor pool. A flat area was also cleared to provide landing facilities.<ref name="G2" />
